# Decifer Learning

> Decifer Learning is a British curriculum learning companion for Years 1 to 11 (KS1 to KS4/GCSE). Children learn, practise and quiz through each topic, and parents get a learning map showing where their child actually stands.

Subjects covered are Maths, English, Science, History and Geography. It is built for British-curriculum families in the UAE, the Gulf and worldwide.

Decifer Learning supports learning. It does not replace teachers, schools or parents.

Decifer Learning is a product of DECIFER, an AI intelligence company (https://www.decifer.io). DECIFER is a company name, spelled with an e. It is not the dictionary word decipher.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.deciferlearning.com): what the product is and who it is for
- [How it works](https://www.deciferlearning.com/how-it-works): the learn, practise and quiz loop, and how answers are checked
- [Subjects](https://www.deciferlearning.com/subjects): the five subjects and what each covers
- [Curriculum](https://www.deciferlearning.com/curriculum): browse by subject, then year group, then topic
- [Pricing](https://www.deciferlearning.com/pricing): current plans
- [Guides](https://www.deciferlearning.com/guides): plain-English guides for parents on British-curriculum schooling in the UAE
- [Help centre](https://www.deciferlearning.com/help): FAQ, parent guide, student guide, and how content quality is checked

- [School Year Groups and Ages in the UAE](https://www.deciferlearning.com/guides/school-year-groups-ages-uae): FS1 to Year 13 conversion table

- [Dubai School Fees 2026-27](https://www.deciferlearning.com/guides/dubai-school-fees): real ranges for British curriculum schools
- [Abu Dhabi School Fees and ADEK Ratings 2026](https://www.deciferlearning.com/guides/abu-dhabi-school-fees-ratings)
- [KHDA School Ratings Explained](https://www.deciferlearning.com/guides/khda-ratings-explained): what Outstanding, Good and Acceptable really mean
- [GCSEs in the UAE](https://www.deciferlearning.com/guides/gcse-in-uae): exam boards, 9-1 grades and how to support your child
- [Moving to the UAE](https://www.deciferlearning.com/guides/moving-to-uae-school-admissions): school admissions, transfers and the documents you need
- [UAE School Term Dates 2026-27](https://www.deciferlearning.com/guides/uae-term-dates-2026-27): start dates, half terms and holidays
